entries.zh: （称重）恰合准星、足秤；分量十足
entries.en: to come exactly to the balance mark; to be of full weight; in great weight
entries.notes: fiel 指天平准星；H 栏「駝」与 M 栏 hō 的对应未明，义据西语 peso/fiel 定。

entries.en: to reach the top; to attain the highest point
entries.notes: L 栏前半与第 1 条重出，empero de quadros 难解，义从 H「到顶」与 M kàu-téng。

entries.zh: 直到世界的尽头、天涯地角
entries.en: to reach the ends of the earth; to go to the end of the world
entries.notes: M 第三音节 gū 不见于 H 栏（仅存「到地」），疑为「久」或「极」，义据 fin del mundo。

entries.zh: 及时而至；转身举步即到
entries.en: to come in time; to arrive at a turn of the foot
entries.notes: L 栏 gel trose parte 严重漫漶，H 首字有「返/这」之疑，语义难定。

entries.en: to reach old age; to grow old
to come upon a convenient time; to arrive opportunely
entries.notes: L 栏末 con~ d^o comen~~ 漫漶，据「遇便」取趁便义。

entries.en: in time; at the right moment

entries.zh: （数目、分量）达到足额；付清款项
entries.en: to come to the exact amount; to make good the payment
entries.notes: L 栏 zuro 当为 justo（恰好）之讹，H「额」与 M cieg 互证。

entries.en: come here
entries.notes: H 末字有「兜/泡」之疑，M táu 支持「兜」（这里）。

entries.en: come here; come along
entries.notes: H「那」与 M nô 的语助用法未详，义从西语 llegar aquí。

entries.en: full; filled
entries.notes: M 栏 mōã 后有缺损；H 字疑为「满」，与 moâⁿ 对音。

entries.en: heaped full; piled to a point (of a filled measure)
entries.notes: 「尖」此处指量器盛满堆尖，非尖锐义。

entries.en: a full year; a completed cycle
entries.notes: M 栏混入 acabado Lāno 西语字样，疑为原稿旁注；义从 H「週」与 con el año。

entries.en: completely full; filled to the utmost
entries.notes: H 字有「完/克」之疑，M chió̃g 疑为「足」，合「满」为足满。

entries.en: full; brimming; abounding
brimming full; full to overflowing
heaped up high; piled to a peak
entries.notes: L 栏残缺，H「尖尖」与 M 互证，取量器堆尖义。

entries.zh: 遍满世界、全世界都满了
entries.en: the whole world over; the world filled full
entries.notes: L、M 均有残缺，M 前半 sī quey 当为「世界」，其后 hūān mī ù 未能辨。

entries.en: to carry in the hand; to hold up in the hand
entries.notes: H 字有「捽/挣」之疑，M qūia 疑为「攑」（gia̍h，拿取）。

entries.en: to hold in the hand; to grasp
entries.notes: H 字有「执/扱」之疑，M chîp 即「执」tsip。
